summary: Frontend testing completed for TopLoader, SetupWizard, and License Expiry Warning features. All 3 features working correctly. TopLoader provides thin orange progress bar at top during page loads. SetupWizard shows multi-step progress messages when creating new sites. License expiry warning displays as plain red text (not badge) in site dashboard header.
critical_code_review_comments: TopLoader.js: Well-implemented with proper z-index (9999), orange gradient styling, and smooth progress animation
SetupWizard.js: Clean implementation with 8 configurable steps, proper data-testid attributes, and accessible design
MainSiteDashboardLayout.js: TopLoader properly integrated using useTopLoader() hook with startLoading/stopLoading based on loading state (lines 171, 175-178)
NetworkDashboard.js: SetupWizard rendered at bottom of component JSX, triggered after successful site creation (line 545)
License expiry warning uses text-red-600 class for plain red text styling as requested
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted 'Test Wizard Site' (/test-wizard-site) for SetupWizard testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: TopLoader, SetupWizard, and License Expiry Warning features all working correctly. TopLoader is a thin 3px bar at z-index 9999 using orange gradient. SetupWizard cycles through 8 steps with durations 1.6s-3s each when creating new sites. License expiry warning shows in MainSiteDashboardLayout header with text-red-600 class (plain red text). Test site was cleaned up.

TopLoader.details: Thin orange progress bar at top (3px height, z-[9999]) with gradient from-orange-500 via-amber-400 to-orange-500. Integrated in NetworkDashboard (fetchMainSites) and MainSiteDashboardLayout (loading state)

SetupWizard.details: Multi-step wizard popup showing progress messages when creating new site. Cycles through 8 steps: creating site, setting up workspace, connecting datacenter, creating menu, preparing, firewall, Clara Global Protect, done. Ends with green 'Get Started' button.
steps_observed: Clara is creating your main site.
We are connecting the workspace to our datacenter.
We are preparing the last things, maybe it's time to sip from your coffee, tea or other drinks.
Setting up the firewall, to keep everything safe.

LicenseExpiryWarning.details: License expiry warning displays in site dashboard header. Uses plain red text styling (class: text-sm text-red-600 font-semibold), NOT a badge with background color as requested.
